theme: One short review, a long open day, and a board that needs decisions.
greeting: A wide-open Sunday with only the nine-o'clock board review on it, Dan — and that review is the moment to finally close the Christmas rental and the December trip, both now past their book-by dates. The girls come back this evening.

needsAttention.title: Reply to Amin on the CIFIC VP role
needsAttention.detail: Amin Noorani (Noorani + Partners) wrote Wednesday about the VP, Government Relations & Regulatory Affairs search at CIFIC and offered to talk it through whenever you want. Squarely your capital-markets and regulatory lane; awaiting your reply.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: p1 and ~5 weeks overdue. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out — a refundable hold costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: Decide and book the December trip
needsAttention.detail: Decide-by (Sept 30) and book-by (Oct 15) both passed. Three weeks, six people, over the holidays — thinnest inventory of the year; the board default is go domestic unless someone wants international.

needsAttention.title: Close out the Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 window to move the Pathfinder Portland→St Pete ends today — confirm it's done or settle it at the review; it's what kills the monthly rental spend.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: Clear the board, own and date everything — 15 min

resolved: Toronto trip locked in — the Nov 2–5 photo-studio loft is confirmed on Airbnb and the flights are booked and paid.

acts.line: One fifteen-minute review with Mike at nine, then the morning opens up.
Nothing on the calendar — the long, unhurried middle of a Sunday.
The handoff lands around six; the house fills back up with the girls.
